label: Alarm Lifecycle Simulation
info:
Self-running alarm lifecycle simulation.

Every few seconds a random alarm is raised. After a random delay it gets
acknowledged, and after another random delay the condition clears.
The event-alarm nodes track the full ISA-18.2 lifecycle.

Both lifecycle paths are exercised:
  Path A: Raised > Acked > Cleared (Resolved)
  Path B: Raised > Cleared > Acked (Resolved)
